Fix pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1111

RED->GREEN discipline (rebar-debug Phase 2):
- RED oracle: tests/unit/test_guides.py — contract-parity tests across the two public seams the CLI uses, explain_guide('plan') and explain_criterion('G6'). Confirmed legitimately RED first (2 failed, 8 passed) and failing for the right reason; one initially failed for the WRONG reason (my section split truncated at the fenced example's own '##' headings) and was corrected to bound by the fence BEFORE any fix existed.
- The oracle was moved out of the fix subagent's worktree entirely; the fixer received only the frozen contract card and never saw the test. GREEN afterwards: 10 passed.
- Mutation check (teeth): re-introducing the exact root cause returned the oracle to RED — restoring the template directive -> 1 failed; restoring the worked-example 'Rejected:' line -> 2 failed. Restoring the fix -> 10 passed.
- Negative-control teeth: stripping the rationale from the Approach bullet -> test_guide_still_requires_a_positive_rationale goes RED, proving the fix must reframe rather than merely delete.
- Replication of the original report: 'rebar explain plan' now yields no rejected-alternative directive, while 'rebar explain G6' still carries the anti-priming clause.

Fix (7 insertions, 5 deletions, one file): reworded the four author-facing sites — description-template bullet, blocking-checklist entry, worked example's Approach block, and the note after it. The requirement is reframed to G6's positive rationale, not deleted.

Fix-safety audit: restoration not creation (no new capability/entry point); no new dependency; no pre-existing test weakened (the test diff is 86 insertions, 0 deletions).

Sibling sweep: no siblings. Remaining repo hits for 'Rejected:' are ADR design records, which is the legitimate place for rejected alternatives (docs/adr/0055:301), plus this test's own fixture strings.

Gates: make lint clean, make typecheck clean (399 files), targeted regression subset 98 passed. Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before close.

Follow-up filed: 2f3c-6303-709d-49a0 (linked discovered_from) — there is no parity gate between the packaged prose guides and the criteria registry, which is why this drift went unnoticed for a month. Out of scope for this fix.
